name: High School Honors
what_you_do: You take two BU undergraduate courses. You can earn up to 8 college credits in six weeks. You can be a residential or commuter student. You learn alongside BU undergraduates.
who_can_apply: Students entering their junior or senior year of high school in fall 2027. Juniors need to be in Honors and/or AP courses.
pay_detail: Summer 2026 total was $7,245 (commuter, 8 credits) or $11,565 (residential, 8 credits), plus a $75 application fee. Summer 2027 costs post December 17, 2026. Limited financial aid (need and merit).
duration: 6 weeks; 2027 dates pending approval: June 27 to August 6, 2027
deadline_text: Applications open on December 17. The page does not list a final deadline.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application with transcript, a 500 to 750 word personal statement and one academic teacher recommendation. The student must apply, not a parent or counselor.
notes: Expensive. 2027 dates are pending approval and may change. Standardized test scores are optional for summer 2027. Contact: summerhs@bu.edu.
